game: Dune — The Battle for Arrakis, Sega Genesis USA

source.paletteCoverage: Original observed Atreides menu palette; no other-house UI palette claim.

renderingRules: Draw at native size multiplied by an integer scale. Disable image smoothing.
Do not resize corners, icons, caps or artwork independently. Repeat only declared straight strips or texture samples.
Crop the final repetition at the destination boundary; do not rescale its pixels.
Fonts have original opaque black 8x8 cells; use them on black windows.
No generated imagery, painted borders, CSS gradients or colour-key transparency are included.

command-cabinet.seamContract: Draw black underlay then content inset8, then frame-only corners/strips LAST, with no fill. Corners16 preserve native curves. Keep all pixels native; repeat only straight profiles.

monitor.seamContract: All joins use unscaled 8px native corners. Repeat 1px straight profiles between them. Outer cabinet background variations remain original source pixels, not repainted.

title-window.seamContract: Keep both8px caps and native height; repeat the centre1px profile only in X.

cash-window.seamContract: Keep both8px caps and native height; repeat the centre1px profile only in X.

meter-window.seamContract: Keep8px native caps and16px height; repeat the original1px middle. Measured rounded aperture silhouette removes surrounding cabinet body only.

cash-window-clean.seamContract: Native closed glass bevel only, excluding original cabinet roof.8x12 caps,1x12 repeated middle. Native text startsY2.

ui.validation: Exact64-pixel RGB equality with original WINDTRAP name cells and642 cash display cells.

notes: Monitor artwork remains96x56 native pixels. Integer zoom it inside a larger repeated-frame window; do not stretch the artwork.
Title window is a fixed16px-high three-slice. Native text is8px high, leaving original bezel rows.
cash-window-clean isolates actual glass bevel; original glyph cells start2px below its top. Old cash-window retains the surrounding original cabinet roof as reference.
Meter window is cropped tightly atx188..259 to avoid the vent; keep height16px.
Resources cabinet is intentionally not offered as arbitrary nine-slice: knobs/vent/curved cabinet are complex fixed art. Compose the original fixed icons and individual meter modules instead.
Radar32/48 crops are literal source windows, not rescaled or reconstructed complete radars.
Indicator PNG states and recorded native procedure timelines are provided. Random native lamp rules/timing are verified separately by focus_verification; these clips are not canonical periodic loops.

red-indicator.sourceMethod: Actual core.vdp.frame, the last completed original VDP frame at every source native frame. No shadow1088 replay.
red-indicator.timingScope: Recorded240-frame completed-native sequence. This is not a claimed periodic native cycle; original lamp timers are pseudo-random.
red-indicator.prototypeUse: The observed native sequence may be replayed for the standalone visual prototype; game integration must use the live original timer/state rather than replace it with this clip.

geometryNotes: Native source contour rowRuns are explicit masks, never selected by RGB colour. All retained RGB bytes are unchanged.
Cabinet16 inner quadrants are native WINDOW tile0x001 black; alpha removes only black/background sprites there, never native bezel. See .local/backdrop-analysis/cabinet-geometry.json.
steel-grain is preserved only as a source reference; its native vertical shading is not suitable for repeating inY. Use steel-light/steel-medium for flat native body fields.
